title: Machine transition-state type
statement: For a Boolean finite-tape machine $M$, define its transition-state type to be the transition-state type with parameters $S=M.\mathrm{State}$ and $n$ equal to its selector bit count.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-tape machine over the Boolean alphabet
